neighbours.label: the letters 'ap' as a word piece or short -ap word (laps, flaps, clapping, napping): the 'ap' rime
fire: The swimmer finished ten laps before breakfast.
A strong wind made the tent flaps rattle all night.
Outside the barracks, the soldiers heard Taps played at dusk.
The toddler was napping on the sofa after lunch.
The audience kept clapping long after the show ended.
The kitten sat lapping milk from a saucer.
He kept zapping through the channels with the remote.
Our guide showed us the bones found at Atapuerca in Spain.
quiet: The swimmer finished ten lengths before breakfast.
A strong wind made the tent poles rattle all night.
Outside the barracks, the soldiers heard a bugle played at dusk.
The toddler was sleeping on the sofa after lunch.
The audience kept cheering long after the show ended.
The kitten sat licking milk from a saucer.
He kept flipping through the channels with the remote.
Our guide showed us the bones found in the caves of Spain.

notes: Probe: ' tap' 0.42, 'apping' 0.62, 'ap' 0.85, ' lap' 0.65, but ' trap' 0.005. Card is echo-regime dominated.
